thread:
jamie: Heads up — saw a spike of fncall schema rejections after the payment toolhook rollout. logs show `tool=payment_resolver fncall=resolve err=json_schema_error`

srini: saw that too. dashboard shows rejects up 10x for /v1/invoke -> payment_resolver. Not sure if it's the strict validator or malformed payloads.

emily: can we circuit-break just that tool instance instead of the whole route? noise affects metrics and alerts.

ben: +1. Quick idea: when validation errors > 100/min for a tool, route to permissive variant and emit metric `fncall.soft_fallback` with tag `reason=schema_reject`.

jamie: we already have per-tool backoff tuned for latency. it doesn't consider schema rejects as a signal so it doesn't flip. need finer-grained reject reasons.

srini: telemetry side — we can add a `fncall.reject_reason` tag (enum: schema, timeout, parse) to the existing counter. start with 1% payload sampling for schema cases to keep costs low.

emily: console UX: we should show per-tool reject counts + top reject reasons + one sampled offending payload. right now the dashboard only shows an aggregate "fncall rejects" graph so teams can't debug.

ben: agreed. Also need a clear rollback toggle on the rollout page to disable strict validation per-tool. currently ops flip flags in infra and it's opaque for devs.

jamie: short-term plan: add a circuit-breaker rule: if `tool.schema_rejects > 200` in 5m then route to variant `payment_resolver:permissive-v1` and post to #eng-oncall. long-term: console controls + sampled payload storage.

deploy-bot: Alert created: `fncall-schema-high` for payment_resolver (threshold=200/5m) -> channel #eng-oncall.

srini: who's owning the console card for reject_reason? emily?

emily: i can take console work — will add a card showing reject_reason breakdown, top sample (rotating), and a "disable strict validation" toggle. aiming for PR by EOD tomorrow.

ben: telemetry: can you add the tag and a tiny sampling pipeline? proposal: 0.1% full-payload capture for schema rejects, stored for 7 days.

srini: also ensure billing/quota attribution excludes permissive fallbacks from retry counts. otherwise teams get charged for degraded routing.

jamie: good call. route should set header `x-fallback-reason=permissive_schema` so billing & quota can filter it out.

emily: i'll wire the UX to show when a route is in permissive mode and expose the sample id.

ben: other concerns — audit logs for rollout flips and aopt-in for teams to allow permissive fallbacks.

jamie: let's sync offline 10am to finalize thresholds and the alert name. thanks all :thumbsup:
